تنتقشي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِشِي (tantaqišī) /tan.ta.qi.ʃiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
# تُنْتَقَشِي (tuntaqašī) /tun.ta.qa.ʃiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
